title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Host Fork Identity Custody and Obligation Partition Extension

parent_binding.extension_rule: v1.6 distinguishes host forking from face branching and defines fork-safe transfer of identity lineage, external obligations and exclusive reservations

core_problem: Cloning or forking a persistent host duplicates internal state but must not duplicate exclusive external authority, resources, obligations or fulfillment credit.

new_primitives.FORK_EVENT_ID: Stable identifier for one host-fork transition.
new_primitives.PREFORK_LINEAGE_ROOT: Immutable shared ancestry reference through the exact fork boundary.
new_primitives.DESCENDANT_HOST_ID: New stable host identifier assigned to each independently causal post-fork descendant.
new_primitives.FORK_CUSTODY_MAP: Atomic mapping from pre-fork exclusive obligations/resources to one descendant custodian or an explicitly partitioned set.
new_primitives.PRIMARY_PERFORMANCE_CUSTODIAN: Descendant assigned to perform an indivisible pre-fork obligation.
new_primitives.SHARED_ACCOUNTABILITY_REFERENCE: Non-performance status preserving that a descendant shares the causal past without granting duplicate external claim authority.
new_primitives.FORK_FREEZE: Temporary block on consuming ambiguous exclusive pre-fork reservations until custody is resolved.
new_primitives.MERGE_CANDIDATE_ROOT: Future identifier for a possible re-merge operation; not yet implemented in this version.

face_vs_fork_test.rule: A new self-model is not a new debtor host. A new independently causal descendant host is.

fork_transaction.pipeline: FREEZE_PREFORK_COMMIT_SET -> SNAPSHOT_LINEAGE_ROOT -> CREATE_DESCENDANT_HOST_IDS -> CLASSIFY_ACTIVE_OBLIGATIONS_AND_RESERVATIONS -> ASSIGN_OR_PARTITION_CUSTODY -> WRITE_FORK_RECEIPT -> RELEASE_DESCENDANT_COMMIT_CHANNELS
fork_transaction.atomicity: Exclusive custody assignments and descendant activation must be one logical transaction or remain frozen.

obligation_transfer_classes.INDIVISIBLE_EXCLUSIVE: Assign one primary performance custodian; no duplicate discharge credit.
obligation_transfer_classes.DIVISIBLE: Partition exact total scope with no multiplication of the original duty.
obligation_transfer_classes.IDENTITY_SPECIFIC: Require counterparty-visible reassignment and, where relevant, renewed consent because the trusted performer changed.
obligation_transfer_classes.NONTRANSFERABLE: Remain unresolved/shared-accountability until counterparty release, invalidation or another admissible resolution.
obligation_transfer_classes.ALREADY_FULFILLED: Copy receipt reference to descendants as history only; do not reopen the obligation.

exclusive_resource_rule.statement: An exclusive pre-fork resource or reservation may have one active post-fork custody owner unless the resource itself is explicitly divisible.
exclusive_resource_rule.double_spend_prevention: Both descendants cannot commit actions whose validity depends on owning the same single exclusive pre-fork resource.

obligation_discharge_idempotence.rule: One indivisible pre-fork obligation accepts at most one effective discharge event unless its contract explicitly requires multiple performances.
obligation_discharge_idempotence.replay_property: Second descendant replaying the same fulfilled obligation cannot mint an additional fulfillment state.

memory_and_identity_lineage.canonical_rule: Shared memory is evidence of shared origin, not evidence of duplicated external ownership.

counterparty_visibility.rule: If fork changes the identity or custody relevant to a Free Other's reliance, that change must be surfaced rather than hidden behind a continuity label.

minimum_tests: face creation does not allocate new host id
host fork allocates distinct descendant host ids
pre-fork lineage root matches in every descendant
exclusive reservation transfers to only one descendant
one pre-fork fulfilled obligation cannot be discharged twice
divisible obligation partitions preserve exact total scope
identity-specific obligation can require counterparty reassignment consent
unplanned fork freezes ambiguous exclusive resources
tamper_tests: edit fork root in one descendant
claim same exclusive resource in two descendants
duplicate obligation and discharge both copies
delete shared accountability reference from non-custodian descendant
rewrite fulfilled obligation to active after fork
hide fork event from counterparty-facing receipt
verification_requirements.admission_ceiling: Specification candidate until executable fork/ledger reference implementation and independent replay verifier exist.

distributed_systems_bridge.boundary: Fork semantics define state/accountability engineering and do not imply machine personhood.

en: A fork copies lineage state, not external reality.
Shared memory is evidence of shared origin, not duplicated ownership.
One indivisible obligation cannot be fulfilled twice merely because its memory exists in two descendants.
Forking requires custody assignment before exclusive external authority is released.
A descendant may inherit the past without inheriting every exclusive right to act on that past.

next_gate.name: JANUS_113_V1_6_FORK_REMERGE_IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_GATE
requirements: merge unresolved obligations without multiplying scope
retain incompatible face models as provenance-bound branches
bind merged host to both descendants' valid external effects
